raw_response:
This small plot near my home is where I keep my enset and some coffee trees, with a few vegetables growing between them. I have no money for chemical fertilizer on this plot, and anyway these perennials do better with the manure from my few animals and the kitchen waste we throw around the base of the plants. The trees are already established from years past, so I just need to weed, mulch, and tend them with my own hands and my wife's help. We do not have water to irrigate here — we wait for the rains like everyone else.
